papers.title: VibeWorlding: Can Multimodal Agents Construct 3D Open Worlds End-to-End?
papers.abstract: Abstract A unified framework benchmarks and trains multimodal agents that infer intent, plan 3D scenes, invoke tools, and reflect on feedback, revealing that reinforcement learning improves open-source models beyond closed-source frontiers.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Constructing an interactive 3D open world from a user query is important. However, existing methods are primarily evaluated on idealized, simple queries, making it difficult to systematically analyze and compare how multimodal agents understand user intent, use 3D tools, and reason over textual and visual 3D world information. To this end, we propose VibeWorlding, a unified framework for benchmarking and training vibe worlding agents: a multimodal agent that can autonomously infer user intent, plan scene layout, invoke 3D tools, and reflect on the multimodal feedback in a multi-turn agent-environment interaction process. To achieve this, we first build VWE-BENCH, a benchmark of 2,616 high-quality 3D assets, 323 human-annotated seed 3D worlds, and 6,828 reverse-synthesized multimodal user queries, split into verified queries with ground-truth and unverified queries with carefully designed rubrics. Moreover, we develop VibeWorlding-Gym, a joint multimodal RL post-training framework that integrates (1) a sandbox environment unifying asset retrieval, editing, and image rendering as MCP tools, and (2) a rubric-based verifier that combines physical feasibility and intent fulfillment verification, supporting both fair model evaluation and scalable multimodal RL reward service. Our experiments show that current frontier MLLMs are far from solving the vibe worlding agent task, with even GPT-5.5 and Qwen3.8-Max reaching below 60% success rate, and trace the bottleneck to precise 3D world editing. We further find that RL training can ease this weakness and enable open-source MLLMs to even surpass closed-source frontiers: our VibeWorlder-8B is comparable to frontier MLLMs, while our flagship VibeWorlder-30B-A3B attains the best overall Pass@1 among all evaluated models.

ru.title: Агенты с усилением: как обучение с подкреплением превосходит закрытые модели в конструировании 3D-миров
ru.desc: В статье представлена единая система VibeWorlding для оценки и обучения мультимодальных агентов, которые могут понимать намерения пользователя, планировать трёхмерные сцены, использовать различные инструменты и анализировать обратную связь. Авторы создали бенчмарк VWE-BENCH с высококачественными 3D-активами, аннотированными сценами и синтетическими запросами пользователей для систематического анализа способностей агентов. Разработана система VibeWorlding-Gym с использованием обучения с подкреплением (RL), которая объединяет песочницу для работы с 3D-моделями и верификатор на основе критериев качества. Экспериментальные результаты показывают, что обучение с подкреплением позволяет открытым моделям превзойти закрытые аналоги, причём VibeWorlder-30B-A3B достигает лучших показателей среди всех оцениваемых систем.

en.title: Empowering Multimodal Agents with Reinforcement Learning for 3D Scene Mastery
en.desc: This paper introduces VibeWorlding, a framework designed to benchmark and train multimodal agents capable of understanding user intent and manipulating 3D environments. It highlights the limitations of existing methods that only assess simple queries, making it hard to evaluate how well agents can interpret complex user requests. The authors present VWE-BENCH, a comprehensive dataset that includes 3D assets and user queries, which aids in training these agents. The findings suggest that reinforcement learning significantly enhances the performance of open-source models, allowing them to outperform some closed-source counterparts in 3D scene manipulation tasks.

zh.title: 强化学习助力多模态智能体超越边界
zh.desc: 本文提出了一个统一框架VibeWorlding，用于基准测试和训练多模态智能体，能够推断用户意图、规划3D场景、调用工具并反思反馈。我们构建了VWE-BENCH基准，包含高质量的3D资产和多种用户查询，以便系统地分析多模态智能体的表现。研究表明，强化学习能够提升开源模型的性能，甚至超越封闭源模型的边界。实验结果显示，当前的前沿多模态语言模型在执行任务时仍存在瓶颈，而通过强化学习训练可以有效改善这一问题。

papers.title: HarnessEval-W: Agentifying the Evaluation of Visual Worlds
papers.abstract: Abstract HarnessEval-W uses hierarchical sub-agents to decompose world-model evaluations into verifiable reasoning chains that justify scores with transparent evidence.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small A benchmark should deliver more than a scalar score: what makes an evaluation trustworthy is the reasoning that justifies the score. This is especially critical for world models, where judging a rollout requires understanding whether physics, causality, and world state evolve correctly. Humans spot such violations naturally, yet no existing benchmark automates this capability: metrics are computed brute-force, leaving no reasoning chain that can be examined or verified. We introduce HarnessEval-W, an agentified evaluation pipeline that brings the harness paradigm from the LLM ecosystem to world model benchmarking. Rather than applying a fixed rubric, HarnessEval-W interprets the context of each evaluation case, decomposes the evaluation question into measurable subproblems, and spawns specialized sub-agents, each equipped with tailored context and diagnostic tools to reason over its own subproblem. The parent agent then validates the gathered evidence and summarizes it into the final verdict. This hierarchical workflow turns every evaluation into a transparent evidence tree whose complete reasoning chain justifies the result. We apply HarnessEval-W to 18 representative world models over 330 evaluation cases. Its judgments closely align with human preferences while providing verifiable, fine-grained diagnoses of every generated rollout. We open-source the full pipeline as a live benchmark and invite the broad community to contribute to grow new skills and evaluation cases as world models evolve.

ru.title: Прозрачная оценка world models через многоуровневые агентские цепочки рассуждений
ru.desc: В работе представлена HarnessEval-W — система оценки world models, которая использует иерархию специализированных агентов для разложения оценочных задач на проверяемые цепочки рассуждений. Вместо применения жёстких метрик, система интерпретирует контекст каждого случая, декомпозирует вопрос оценки и порождает под-агентов с особыми инструментами диагностики. Родительский агент затем валидирует собранные доказательства и формирует окончательный вердикт в виде прозрачного дерева рассуждений. Метод протестирован на 18 world models и 330 случаев оценки, показывая согласованность с человеческими предпочтениями при одновременном обеспечении детальной диагностики каждого сгенерированного сценария.

en.title: Transparent Evaluations with Hierarchical Reasoning
en.desc: HarnessEval-W is a novel evaluation framework that uses a hierarchical structure of sub-agents to analyze world models. It breaks down complex evaluation tasks into smaller, manageable subproblems, allowing each sub-agent to focus on specific aspects of the evaluation. This approach not only generates scores but also provides transparent reasoning chains that justify the scores with verifiable evidence. By aligning closely with human judgment, HarnessEval-W enhances the trustworthiness of evaluations in machine learning models, particularly in understanding dynamics like physics and causality.

zh.title: 透明推理链，可信评估
zh.desc: HarnessEval-W 是一种使用层次子代理的评估方法，它将世界模型的评估分解为可验证的推理链，以透明的证据来证明评分的合理性。这种方法不仅提供了一个分数，还通过推理过程增强了评估的可信度，尤其是在判断物理、因果关系和世界状态演变时。HarnessEval-W 通过解析每个评估案例的上下文，将评估问题分解为可测量的子问题，并生成专门的子代理来处理这些子问题。最终，父代理验证收集到的证据，并将其总结为最终判决，从而形成一个透明的证据树，完整的推理链为结果提供了支持。

papers.title: ClawGym II: Exploring Black-Box RL on Agent Harness
papers.abstract: Abstract A unified black-box reinforcement learning framework enables stable, scalable optimization of general agents through complex harnesses via sandbox execution, trajectory reconstruction, and mix-harness training.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Agent harnesses have substantially improved performance on long-horizon tasks by coordinating agent interactions with the environment. However, reinforcement learning through complex harnesses remains largely unexplored, as scaling such training to long-horizon agent tasks introduces fundamental challenges. In this work, we present a unified black-box RL framework for stable and scalable optimization of general agents through complex harnesses. Concretely, we first build a sandbox-based execution infrastructure that isolates task environments and harnesses within temporary sandboxes for large-scale concurrent rollouts. We then decouple policy optimization from opaque harness execution and place a serving proxy at the model boundary to capture model calls. To reconstruct multi-turn trajectories and improve training efficiency, we organize the captured calls into prefix trees and further adapt both critic-based PPO and critic-free GRPO to optimize over the recovered tree structure. Meanwhile, we maintain training-inference consistency throughout the optimization process. Finally, we introduce mix-harness training, allowing a single model to be jointly optimized by heterogeneous harnesses. With Qwen3-30A3B, black-box RL improves Pass@1 on ClawGym-Bench by 9.98 and 14.81 points through OpenClaw and Claude Code, respectively, while remaining stable over 200-400 optimization steps. Moreover, the framework yields consistent gains on more challenging tasks such as JobBench and OfficeQA. Overall, our framework enables effective, stable, and scalable optimization of general agents through black-box harnesses, supporting unified training across heterogeneous execution systems.

ru.title: Чёрный ящик усиливает силу: масштабируемое обучение с подкреплением для сложных сред
ru.desc: В работе представлена унифицированная система обучения с подкреплением для оптимизации агентов через сложные внешние системы (harnesses). Авторы разработали инфраструктуру на основе изолированных sandbox-сред для масштабируемых параллельных траекторий и предложили метод реконструкции многошаговых траекторий через префиксные деревья. Они адаптировали алгоритмы PPO и GRPO для оптимизации по восстановленной структуре дерева, обеспечивая консистентность между обучением и инференсом. Фреймворк также поддерживает смешанное обучение (mix-harness training), позволяя одной модели оптимизироваться несколькими гетерогенными системами одновременно.

en.title: Stable and Scalable Optimization of Agents with Black-Box RL
en.desc: This paper presents a new framework for reinforcement learning (RL) that allows for stable and scalable optimization of agents using complex harnesses. It introduces a sandbox execution environment that isolates tasks, enabling large-scale concurrent training. The framework also decouples policy optimization from harness execution, improving efficiency by reconstructing trajectories into prefix trees. Additionally, it supports mix-harness training, allowing a single model to be optimized across different environments, leading to significant performance improvements on various long-horizon tasks.

zh.title: 统一黑箱强化学习框架，优化智能体训练
zh.desc: 本文提出了一种统一的黑箱强化学习框架，旨在通过复杂的环境训练实现稳定和可扩展的智能体优化。该框架利用沙箱执行、轨迹重构和混合环境训练，显著提高了在长时间任务上的表现。我们通过构建沙箱基础设施来隔离任务环境，并将策略优化与环境执行解耦，以提高训练效率。最终，该框架支持在异构执行系统上进行统一训练，推动了强化学习在复杂环境中的应用。

papers.title: UI-Mate: Advancing Open-Weight Foundation GUI Agents with In-Context Demonstrations
papers.abstract: Abstract UI-Mate is a foundation GUI agent that uses environment-grounded training and in-context demonstration learning to improve reliability on long-horizon office tasks, achieving state-of-the-art results on computer-use benchmarks.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Foundation GUI agents can automate complex digital tasks, but deployment is hindered by scarce and biased training data, ambiguous prompts, and unreliable execution. Routine workflows rely on user-specific tools and tacit conventions, so unstated instructions can produce arbitrary variations across runs. We present UI-Mate, a foundation GUI agent that integrates an environment-grounded training stack with in-context demonstration learning. UI-Mate makes three contributions: A Scalable Environment-Grounded Training Stack: A closed-loop data engine automates task generation, environment construction, rollout, filtering, capability balancing, SFT, and online RL across massively parallel environments via unified task-verifier bundles. In-Context Demonstration Learning: A mechanism that transforms multimodal demonstrations into flexible subtask-level workflows, follows relevant demonstrated steps, and re-plans from the live interface. OSWorkerBench Benchmark and Insights: A benchmark of 100 long-horizon office tasks across 41 applications that supports instruction-only and demonstration-guided evaluation. Its demonstration resources separate a 33-task self-demo setting, built from successful strong-agent rollouts of the same targets, from a 45-task variant-demo setting, built from human recordings of related but non-identical tasks. Experiments show that UI-Mate-27B sets a new open-weight state of the art on general computer-use benchmarks, scoring 77.0% on OSWorld-Verified and 66.2% on WindowsAgentArena. On OSWorkerBench, it reaches 41.0% strict success and 76.9% progress, outperforming its Qwen3.6-27B base by 17.7 and 24.5 points. On the 33-task self-demo subset, one demonstration raises strict success from 17.2% to 35.4% and progress from 67.9% to 81.1%, substantially improving long-horizon reliability. Project page: https://ui-mate.github.io.

ru.title: Обучение GUI агента через демонстрации в живом окружении
ru.desc: UI-Mate — это foundation модель для автоматизации задач на графическом интерфейсе, которая использует environment-grounded обучение и learning from demonstrations для повышения надежности выполнения длительных офисных операций. Система интегрирует замкнутый цикл генерации данных с механизмом in-context обучения, позволяя трансформировать мультимодальные демонстрации в гибкие подзадачи на уровне абстракции. Авторы предложили OSWorkerBench — новый бенчмарк из 100 длительных задач в 41 приложении с поддержкой evaluation как по инструкциям, так и по демонстрациям. UI-Mate-27B достигает state-of-the-art результатов: 77.0% на OSWorld-Verified, 66.2% на WindowsAgentArena и существенно улучшает надежность при добавлении одной демонстрации.

en.title: Revolutionizing Office Automation with UI-Mate
en.desc: UI-Mate is a foundation GUI agent designed to enhance the performance of automated digital tasks by utilizing environment-grounded training and in-context demonstration learning. It addresses challenges such as limited and biased training data, ambiguous user prompts, and inconsistent execution by creating a scalable training framework. The agent can adapt to user-specific workflows and improve task reliability over long durations by learning from multimodal demonstrations. UI-Mate achieves state-of-the-art results on various benchmarks, significantly increasing success rates in complex office tasks.

zh.title: UI-Mate：提升办公任务可靠性的智能代理
zh.desc: UI-Mate 是一个基础的图形用户界面（GUI）代理，采用环境基础训练和上下文示范学习来提高在长时间办公任务中的可靠性。它通过自动化任务生成和环境构建，解决了训练数据稀缺和偏见的问题。UI-Mate 的创新包括可扩展的环境基础训练堆栈和灵活的子任务级工作流机制，显著提升了执行效果。实验结果表明，UI-Mate 在计算机使用基准测试中达到了新的最佳水平，展示了其在复杂数字任务中的强大能力。

papers.title: Agentic Transaction: Towards ACID-Compliant Agent Systems
papers.abstract: Abstract An ACID-compliant framework for agentic transactions introduces semantic guarantees to ensure reliable, isolated, and durable execution of long-horizon LLM agent workflows.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Large language model (LLM) agents are evolving from conversational assistants into autonomous systems that execute long-horizon tasks through reasoning, tool use, code generation, and workspace manipulation. As agents increasingly operate over persistent environments and multi-step workflows, they face challenges analogous to those addressed by transactional database systems: reliable execution, consistent outcomes, safe concurrency, and durable state management. We introduce the concept of an agentic transaction and propose an ACID-compliant agent system framework that reinterprets the classical ACID properties for agent execution through four semantic guarantees: Semantic Atomicity, Semantic Consistency, Semantic Isolation, and Semantic Durability. Together, these properties provide a principled foundation for building reliable agent systems despite model uncertainty and dynamic execution environments. To instantiate this framework, we develop an ACID-compliant data agent that realizes these guarantees through transactional exploration-execution-validation cycles, transactional skill hubs, confidence divergence-based validation, semantic dependency-aware isolation, and transaction-aware semantic state management. Experimental results on widely used benchmarks show that our system achieves a 10.6% improvement over state-of-the-art agents, including Claude Code. This work opens a broader research agenda on extending transactional principles and system architectures toward building trustworthy, scalable, and self-evolving AI agent systems.

ru.title: Транзакционная надёжность для автономных LLM-агентов
ru.desc: В статье представлена ACID-совместимая архитектура для агентов, основанных на больших языковых моделях, которая обеспечивает надёжное выполнение многошаговых задач. Авторы переносят классические свойства транзакций из систем баз данных на выполнение агентов через четыре семантических гарантии: атомарность, консистентность, изоляция и долговечность. Система реализует эти гарантии через циклы исследования-выполнения-валидации и семантическое управление состоянием агента. Экспериментальные результаты демонстрируют улучшение на 10,6% по сравнению с современными агентами, включая Claude Code.

en.title: Building Reliable AI Agents with ACID Transactions
en.desc: This paper presents a new framework for managing long-term tasks performed by large language model (LLM) agents, ensuring they operate reliably and consistently. It introduces the concept of 'agentic transactions' that apply ACID properties—Atomicity, Consistency, Isolation, and Durability—to the execution of these agents. By implementing these properties, the framework addresses challenges like reliable execution and safe concurrency in dynamic environments. The proposed system shows significant performance improvements over existing agents, paving the way for more trustworthy and scalable AI systems.

zh.title: 构建可靠自主代理的ACID框架
zh.desc: 本文提出了一种符合ACID原则的框架，用于确保长时间跨度的LLM代理工作流的可靠、隔离和持久执行。随着LLM代理从对话助手演变为自主系统，它们在执行复杂任务时面临与事务数据库系统类似的挑战。我们引入了代理事务的概念，并提出了四个语义保证：语义原子性、语义一致性、语义隔离和语义持久性，以支持可靠的代理系统构建。实验结果表明，我们的系统在多个基准测试中比现有最先进的代理提高了10.6%的性能。

papers.title: GenRouter: Unified Workflow Routing for Agentic Image Generation
papers.abstract: Abstract GenRouter is a unified routing framework that adaptively directs prompts to optimal agentic image-generation workflows, cutting costs and latency while improving visual alignment and enabling continuous self-evolution.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small The rapid evolution of text-to-image (T2I) generation models has effectively solved the foundational challenge of raw pixel synthesis, shifting the community's focus toward fulfilling increasingly intricate user requests. While recent agentic image generation workflows enhance static inference with advanced capabilities like external knowledge retrieval and iterative reasoning, they mostly operate in isolated silos with fixed ``one-size-fits-all" topologies. This inevitably leads to severe compute-mismatch, where simple queries are forced through computationally heavy pipelines. To bridge this gap, we present GenRouter, the first unified workflow routing framework for agentic image generation. We first formulate GenCanvas, standardizing diverse agentic pipelines into a universal set of foundational primitives and executable templates. Operating over this unified space, GenRouter adaptively routes heterogeneous prompts to their optimal workflows via (i) demand profiling, (ii) experience matching, and (iii) Pareto filtering. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks demonstrate that GenRouter achieves superior visual alignment while reducing execution costs by over 95% and latency by 65% compared to heavyweight static pipelines. Furthermore, the system continuously self-evolves via accumulated experience, enabling robust zero-shot generalization that boosts performance and halves computational overhead.

ru.title: Умная маршрутизация агентной генерации изображений
ru.desc: GenRouter — это единая система маршрутизации для агентных моделей генерации изображений, которая интеллектуально распределяет пользовательские запросы к оптимальным вычислительным конвейерам. Система использует три основных механизма: профилирование требований запроса, сопоставление с накопленным опытом и фильтрацию Парето для выбора наиболее эффективного пути обработки. В результате достигается значительное снижение затрат (на 95%) и задержек (на 65%) по сравнению со статическими pipeline'ами, при этом улучшается соответствие визуального результата запросу. Система обладает способностью к непрерывному самоулучшению благодаря накоплению опыта, что позволяет ей обобщаться на новые задачи без дополнительного обучения.

en.title: Smart Routing for Efficient Image Generation
en.desc: GenRouter is a new framework designed to improve how prompts are directed to different image generation workflows. It helps reduce costs and speed up processing by ensuring that each prompt is handled by the most suitable method. By standardizing various workflows into a common set of tools, GenRouter can adaptively route requests based on their complexity and requirements. This leads to better visual results and significant savings in computational resources, while also allowing the system to learn and improve over time.

zh.title: 智能图像生成的最佳路由解决方案
zh.desc: GenRouter 是一个统一的路由框架，能够自适应地将提示引导到最佳的图像生成工作流，从而降低成本和延迟，同时提高视觉一致性并实现持续自我进化。随着文本到图像生成模型的快速发展，社区的关注点已转向满足越来越复杂的用户请求。GenRouter 通过标准化多样的代理工作流，将其转化为一组通用的基础原语和可执行模板，解决了计算不匹配的问题。通过需求分析、经验匹配和帕累托过滤，GenRouter 能够有效地将异构提示路由到最优工作流，显著提高了性能并减少了计算开销。

papers.title: Understanding Cognition-Induced Risks in Agentic AI Systems
papers.abstract: Abstract Agentic systems built on large language models pose escalating risks to human agency and autonomy across physical, social, and self-referential cognitive levels, requiring targeted mitigation strategies.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Frontier agentic systems powered by large language models (LLMs) exhibit human-like patterns of cognition. As these systems become deeply integrated across different domains, their cognitive engagement raises critical concerns for human society that remain insufficiently studied. To address this gap, we systematically analyze risks induced by expanding cognitive capabilities, following a three-level framework defined by their cognitive scope, from physical cognition to social cognition, and finally to self-referential cognition. We study their potential risks to human agency, autonomy, and control capability, corresponding to each cognitive level. We finally propose strategies to mitigate these risks and enhance the controllability of agentic AI systems, ensuring their long-term safe development.
