ru.title: Контроль и безопасность: трёхуровневая защита человеческой автономии от агентных LLM-систем
ru.desc: В работе анализируются риски, которые создают агентные системы на основе больших языковых моделей для человеческой автономии и свободы воли. Авторы предлагают трёхуровневую классификацию этих рисков: физическое познание, социальное познание и самореферентное познание. Для каждого уровня исследуются потенциальные угрозы контролю человека и его способности принимать независимые решения. В статье также предлагаются стратегии смягчения рисков и повышения управляемости агентных AI-систем для обеспечения их безопасного развития.

en.title: Mitigating Risks of Agentic AI for Human Autonomy
en.desc: This paper discusses the risks associated with agentic systems that use large language models (LLMs) and their impact on human agency and autonomy. It identifies three levels of cognitive engagement: physical, social, and self-referential, each posing unique challenges to human control. The authors analyze how these systems can mimic human-like cognition and the potential dangers that arise as they become more integrated into society. To address these concerns, the paper proposes targeted strategies to mitigate risks and improve the controllability of these advanced AI systems.

zh.title: 自主系统的风险与控制策略
zh.desc: 这篇论文探讨了基于大型语言模型的自主系统对人类自主性和控制能力的潜在风险。研究表明，这些系统在物理、社会和自我认知层面上表现出类似人类的认知模式。随着这些系统在各个领域的深入应用，它们的认知能力引发了对人类社会的重大担忧。论文提出了一种三层框架来分析这些风险，并建议相应的缓解策略，以确保自主人工智能系统的安全发展。

papers.title: MegaParts: Scaling Part-Aware 3D Object Generation to 300 Parts via Token-Efficient Autoregressive Modeling
papers.abstract: Abstract MegaParts scales part-aware 3D generation via token-efficient vector-quantized part tokens and structured autoregressive sequence modeling with long-context training.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Part-aware 3D object generation is essential for graphics applications such as controllable modeling, editing, and articulation, where objects are represented as coherent assemblies of semantic parts. However, existing part-aware generation methods, do not scale well to highly complex objects. As the number of parts increases, generating detailed geometry becomes prohibitively expensive in token length and memory. We introduce MegaParts, a scalable autoregressive 3D generation framework to address this challenge by combining structured sequence modeling with a token-efficient vector-quantized shape tokenizer. Our tokenizer learns discrete latent representations for part-level geometry by minimizing token usage subject to high-fidelity reconstruction, enabling adaptive-length tokenization based on geometric complexity. On top of this compact representation, we train a large language model to generate object bounding boxes, part bounding boxes, and part shape tokens within a unified structured sequence. Combined with efficient long-context training strategy, our token-efficient formulation scales to objects with up to 300 parts and sequence lengths up to 256k tokens. This substantially extends the scale of part-aware 3D generation while preserving compositional structure and enabling fine-grained part-level control. Our method achieves higher mesh quality than baseline autoregressive and diffusion models, showing that compressed discrete part tokens improve not only scalability but also the achievable fidelity of generated geometry. These results suggest that LLM native token-efficient autoregressive modeling is a compelling alternative to diffusion for large-scale part-aware 3D generation. The project page is available at https://expmaster.github.io/megaparts_webpage.
affiliations: University of Science and Technology of China

ru.title: Экономные токены для генерации сложных многодетальных 3D объектов
ru.desc: MegaParts представляет новый метод для генерации сложных 3D объектов, состоящих из множества семантических частей. Авторы разработали эффективный векторный квантизатор, который представляет геометрию отдельных частей в виде компактных дискретных токенов, адаптивно сокращая их количество в зависимости от сложности геометрии. На основе этого представления они обучили большую языковую модель генерировать структурированные последовательности, включающие ограничивающие рамки объектов и частей, а также токены форм, что позволяет обрабатывать объекты с сотнями деталей. Метод демонстрирует, что токен-эффективное авторегрессивное моделирование превосходит диффузионные модели по качеству геометрии и масштабируемости для генерации части-ориентированных 3D моделей.

en.title: Scalable 3D Generation with Part-Aware Precision
en.desc: MegaParts is a novel framework for generating 3D objects that are aware of their parts, which is crucial for applications like modeling and editing. It uses a token-efficient vector-quantized tokenizer to minimize the number of tokens needed while maintaining high-quality geometry. By employing structured autoregressive sequence modeling, it can handle complex objects with up to 300 parts and long sequences of up to 256k tokens. This approach not only improves scalability but also enhances the fidelity of the generated 3D models compared to traditional methods.

zh.title: MegaParts：高效的3D生成新方法
zh.desc: MegaParts 是一种可扩展的自回归 3D 生成框架，旨在解决复杂物体生成中的挑战。它结合了结构化序列建模和高效的向量量化形状标记器，能够在保持高保真重建的同时，减少标记的使用。通过学习离散的潜在表示，MegaParts 可以适应几何复杂度进行动态长度的标记化。该方法在生成具有多达 300 个部分的物体时，显著提高了网格质量，并展示了其在大规模部分感知 3D 生成中的潜力。

papers.title: An Empirical Study of Training Pixel-Space Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
papers.abstract: Abstract Researchers propose a latent-to-pixel training strategy that accelerates convergence and improves inference speed for large-scale pixel-space diffusion models.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small This paper investigates an increasingly important topic in generative modeling: pixel-space diffusion models. Although numerous studies have explored this topic, most focus on small-scale or class-conditional settings. Consequently, a practical recipe for training pixel-space models that rival or exceed well-established latent-space counterparts remains elusive. Through a comprehensive empirical study, we first observe that direct large-scale pre-training in pixel space converges substantially more slowly than in latent space. This observation motivates a latent-to-pixel strategy that acquires generative priors efficiently in latent space and transitions to pixel space during post-training. We then systematically investigate the key design choices governing this transition, including weight initialization, data composition, prediction target, decoder architecture, and noise schedule, and identify a practical recipe that makes the resulting pixel-space models match or outperform their latent-space counterparts while delivering 3.18 to 4.75 times end-to-end inference speedups. We hope that our findings provide useful empirical insights and practical guidelines for future research on pixel-space generation.
affiliations: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

ru.title: От латентного к пиксельному: ускорение диффузионных моделей через гибридное обучение
ru.desc: В статье предлагается стратегия обучения diffusion моделей, которая начинается в скрытом пространстве признаков, а затем переходит в пиксельное пространство для ускорения конвергенции и улучшения скорости инференса. Авторы выявили, что прямое обучение больших моделей диффузии в пиксельном пространстве сходится значительно медленнее, чем в скрытом пространстве. Они систематически исследовали ключевые гиперпараметры переходного этапа: инициализацию весов, состав данных, предсказываемый целевой сигнал, архитектуру декодера и расписание шума. В результате достигнуто ускорение инференса в 3.18-4.75 раза при сохранении или превосходстве качества по сравнению с латентными моделями.

en.title: Accelerating Pixel-Space Diffusion with Latent-to-Pixel Training
en.desc: This paper introduces a novel training approach called latent-to-pixel strategy for pixel-space diffusion models, which enhances both convergence speed and inference efficiency. The authors highlight that traditional large-scale training in pixel space is slower compared to latent space, prompting the need for a more effective method. By leveraging latent space to establish generative priors and then transitioning to pixel space, they achieve significant improvements in model performance. Their systematic analysis of design choices leads to pixel-space models that not only match but can also exceed the capabilities of existing latent-space models, while offering substantial speed advantages during inference.

zh.title: 潜在到像素：加速生成模型的创新策略
zh.desc: 本研究提出了一种潜在到像素的训练策略，旨在加速大规模像素空间扩散模型的收敛速度并提高推理速度。研究表明，直接在像素空间进行大规模预训练的收敛速度明显慢于在潜在空间中的收敛速度。通过系统地研究关键设计选择，作者确定了一种实用的训练方案，使得像素空间模型在性能上能够与潜在空间模型相媲美或超越，同时实现了3.18到4.75倍的推理速度提升。希望这些发现能为未来的像素空间生成研究提供有用的经验见解和实用指导。

papers.title: R^3-Bench: LLMs Struggle with Resource-Rational Reasoning under Shared Budgets
papers.abstract: Abstract R³-Bench reveals that shared computation budgets cause reasoning agents to underperform relative to their single-problem capabilities across math, coding, and abstract reasoning tasks.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small In cognitive science, resource rationality asks how an agent should allocate limited computation to maximize expected value. Most reasoning and agent benchmarks use independent per-task budgets; existing shared-budget studies do not calibrate suite performance against the same model's demonstrated single-problem competence. We introduce R^3-Bench, which evaluates six-problem suites under shared budgets across mathematics, competitive programming, and abstract reasoning in tool-free and agentic settings. Matched single-problem response curves define an offline empirical oracle over observed successes. Across 72 main-table cells for six models, the oracle mean matches or exceeds the contest mean in all cells and is strictly higher in 71. Under moderate tool-free pressure, equal-allocation replay also exceeds contest performance for four of six models. Trajectory diagnostics reveal limited strategy updating and pressure-dependent failure patterns. In a three-model diagnostic under strong agentic pressure, at least one fixed scheduler exceeds the contest mean in six of nine cells, but no policy dominates across domains. These results expose a persistent gap between demonstrated competence and shared-budget realization.
affiliations: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)

ru.title: Как правильно распределить вычисления между задачами для агентов рассуждения
ru.desc: В работе представлен бенчмарк R³-Bench, который исследует, как агенты с рассуждением справляются с задачами при ограниченном вычислительном бюджете, распределённом между несколькими проблемами. Исследователи обнаружили, что при совместном использовании бюджета производительность моделей значительно снижается по сравнению с их способностью решать отдельные задачи независимо. Работа вводит концепцию resource rationality из когнитивной науки и показывает, что стратегии распределения вычислений существенно влияют на итоговую производительность на наборах задач из математики, программирования и абстрактного рассуждения. Результаты выявляют критический разрыв между потенциальными возможностями моделей и их реальной эффективностью в условиях ограниченных ресурсов.

en.title: Bridging the Gap: R³-Bench Reveals Limits of Shared Computation in Reasoning Agents
en.desc: The paper introduces R³-Bench, a new benchmark that evaluates how reasoning agents perform when they share a limited computation budget across multiple tasks, such as math, coding, and abstract reasoning. It highlights that agents often underperform when they have to divide their resources, compared to their performance on single tasks. The study shows that using a matched single-problem response curve can help set a standard for evaluating performance, revealing that agents can achieve better results when their strategies are adjusted based on the task demands. Overall, the findings indicate a significant gap between an agent's individual capabilities and their performance under shared computational constraints.

zh.title: 共享预算下的推理能力挑战
zh.desc: R³-Bench揭示了共享计算预算导致推理代理在数学、编程和抽象推理任务中的表现低于其单一问题能力。该研究探讨了资源理性，分析代理如何在有限的计算资源下最大化预期价值。我们引入R^3-Bench，评估在共享预算下的六个问题套件，涵盖数学、竞争编程和抽象推理。结果显示，尽管存在共享预算的限制，某些模型在特定条件下仍能超越比赛表现，揭示了展示能力与共享预算实现之间的差距。

papers.title: VideoGAIA: A Benchmark for General AI Assistants on Agentic Video Understanding
papers.abstract: Abstract VideoGAIA introduces a multi-turn, tool-augmented benchmark that evaluates agentic video understanding for advanced multimodal models through complex real-world tasks.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Video understanding is a fundamental task for evaluating the capabilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, existing leading models have already achieved approximately 90% accuracy on the Video-MME leaderboard, suggesting that conventional single-turn video understanding tasks are becoming increasingly saturated and insufficient for assessing the intelligence of advanced MLLMs. Towards this end, we introduce VideoGAIA, an agentic video understanding benchmark for general artificial intelligence (AI) assistants. Moving beyond one-shot video question answering, VideoGAIA formulates video understanding as a multi-turn, tool-augmented interaction process, where models must iteratively perceive videos, invoke external tools, gather complementary information, and integrate multimodal evidence across turns. VideoGAIA contains 271 model-human co-designed tasks covering diverse and complex real-world scenarios. Each video-question-answer instance is independently verified by three human experts to ensure both correctness and appropriate difficulty. All evaluated MLLMs, including frontier models such as GPT-5.5 and Kimi-K3, achieve less than 60% accuracy on VideoGAIA, highlighting its value as a high-quality and timely benchmark for evaluating next-generation MLLMs. We hope that VideoGAIA will facilitate the transition from conventional video understanding toward agentic video understanding.
affiliations: The Chinese University of Hong Kong
The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

ru.title: От пассивного анализа к активному агентному пониманию видео
ru.desc: VideoGAIA представляет собой новый бенчмарк для оценки способностей многомодальных больших языковых моделей в задачах понимания видео. В отличие от существующих тестов, где модели достигают ~90% точности, VideoGAIA формулирует понимание видео как многошаговый процесс взаимодействия с инструментами, где модели должны итеративно анализировать видео, вызывать внешние инструменты и интегрировать мультимодальные доказательства. Бенчмарк содержит 271 сложную задачу реального мира, разработанные совместно людьми и моделями, где все современные MLLM показывают менее 60% точности. Это демонстрирует переход от простого ответа на вопросы о видео к агентному пониманию видео с использованием инструментов.

en.title: Elevating Video Understanding: From Single-Turn to Multi-Turn Interactions
en.desc: VideoGAIA is a new benchmark designed to test advanced multimodal large language models (MLLMs) on their ability to understand videos through complex tasks. Unlike traditional single-turn video understanding, it requires models to engage in multi-turn interactions, using external tools and integrating information over several steps. This approach aims to better assess the intelligence of AI assistants by simulating real-world scenarios that demand deeper comprehension and reasoning. The benchmark includes 271 tasks that have been carefully verified for accuracy and difficulty, revealing that even top models struggle with this new challenge, indicating its significance in advancing AI capabilities.

zh.title: VideoGAIA：迈向智能视频理解的新基准
zh.desc: VideoGAIA是一个多轮工具增强基准，旨在评估多模态大语言模型在复杂现实任务中的视频理解能力。现有的模型在单轮视频理解任务上已接近90%的准确率，显示出这些传统任务的饱和性。VideoGAIA通过多轮交互过程，将视频理解转化为一个需要模型迭代感知、调用外部工具和整合多模态证据的任务。该基准包含271个由模型和人类共同设计的任务，确保了评估的准确性和适当的难度。

papers.title: NaviDC-OCR: Navigating Document Parsing Across Digital and Camera-Captured Documents
papers.abstract: Abstract NaviDC-OCR is a unified vision-language framework that integrates deformation-aware learning, adaptive layout sampling, and decoupled content-structure training to improve document parsing accuracy and structural reasoning.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Document parsing aims to transform unstructured documents into structured and machine-readable representations. Recent advances in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have significantly advanced document parsing. However, existing approaches still face two major challenges. First, decoupled VLM-based methods heavily rely on accurate layout analysis, where geometric distortions in camera-captured documents can introduce cascading errors. Second, although end-to-end VLM-based methods alleviate the dependence on explicit layout detection, they often suffer from redundant generation, hallucinations, and insufficient structural reasoning in high-resolution scenarios. To address these challenges, we propose NaviDC-OCR, a unified framework for document parsing. NaviDC-OCR introduces deformation-aware learning to incorporate geometric perception into VLMs and proposes an adaptive sampling mechanism for complex layout representation. Furthermore, a content-structure decoupled learning strategy is developed to explicitly model formula grammars and table structures, enabling more effective structured representation learning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that NaviDC-OCR achieves state-of-the-art performance across diverse document parsing benchmarks. It obtains overall scores of 96.87, 88.53 and 78.41 on OmniDocBench v1.6, Wild-OmniDocBench, and PureDocBench, respectively, and ranks first in the ICDAR 2026 Sci-ImageMiner Challenge. These results validate the effectiveness and generalization capability of NaviDC-OCR in complex document parsing scenarios.
affiliations: China Telecom Artificial Intelligence Technology (Beijing) Co., Ltd.

ru.title: Восприятие деформаций и структурного анализа в документообороте через vision-language модели
ru.desc: NaviDC-OCR — это единая архитектура на основе vision-language моделей для распознавания и структурирования документов. Система использует обучение с учётом деформаций для восприятия геометрических искажений в отсканированных документах и адаптивную выборку для представления сложных макетов. Фреймворк применяет отделённое обучение содержания и структуры, что позволяет более эффективно моделировать формулы и таблицы без избыточной генерации текста. Метод достигает лучших результатов на множестве бенчмарков и занял первое место в конкурсе ICDAR 2026.

en.title: Revolutionizing Document Parsing with NaviDC-OCR
en.desc: NaviDC-OCR is a new framework designed to improve the accuracy of document parsing by combining vision and language processing. It addresses challenges in existing methods, such as errors from layout analysis and issues with generating redundant or inaccurate content. The framework uses deformation-aware learning to better understand document layouts and an adaptive sampling method to handle complex structures. By separating content and structure in its training approach, NaviDC-OCR enhances the ability to represent documents accurately, achieving top performance in various benchmarks.

zh.title: NaviDC-OCR：提升文档解析的智能框架
zh.desc: NaviDC-OCR 是一个统一的视觉-语言框架，旨在提高文档解析的准确性和结构推理能力。它结合了变形感知学习、自适应布局采样和内容-结构解耦训练，以应对现有方法在布局分析和高分辨率场景中的挑战。通过引入几何感知，NaviDC-OCR 能够更好地处理文档中的几何扭曲，并通过解耦学习策略有效建模公式语法和表格结构。实验结果表明，NaviDC-OCR 在多个文档解析基准测试中表现优异，验证了其在复杂文档解析场景中的有效性和泛化能力。

papers.title: PACE-Bench: Benchmarking Physics Adaptation via Code Evolution in Dynamic Environments
papers.abstract: Abstract PACE-Bench evaluates self-evolving agents on physics adaptation tasks requiring iterative code redesign after environmental mutations, revealing that simulator-grounded reflection outperforms unverified self-revision but mechanism redesign remains a major bottleneck.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Self-evolving agents improve future behavior from interaction experience, yet existing evaluations typically optimize under fixed execution conditions and do not test recovery after those conditions change. To address this gap, we introduce PACE-Bench (Physics Adaptation via Code Evolution), a simulator-grounded benchmark of 144 source-to-target adaptation pairs across six physics domains. Each pair links a source environment to a mutated target environment with the same goal and interface. A code-driven design that succeeds in the source fails in the target, where agents must iteratively adapt it into a working target design using diagnostic sandbox feedback within a limited attempt budget. We compare ten self-evolving methods from four paradigms. The benchmark remains far from saturated: Reflexion + Qwen3-14B succeeds on only 35.9\% of full-benchmark pairs, while GPT-5.5 solves 66.7\% of the Statics subset under the full budget. Together, these results show that simulator-grounded reflection is more reliable than unverified self-revision, while memory anchors agents to early designs and broad tree search explores without converging. Even revealing exact physical changes does not raise the performance ceiling, pointing to mechanism redesign rather than parameter inference as the central bottleneck. Data and code are available at https://github.com/thunlp/PACE-Bench.

ru.title: Адаптивные агенты через проверку и переделку кода при изменении физики
ru.desc: В статье представлена PACE-Bench — новый бенчмарк для оценки самоэволюционирующих агентов, которые должны адаптировать код при изменении физического окружения. Агентам требуется итеративно переделывать дизайн решения, используя обратную связь от симулятора, когда исходная стратегия перестаёт работать в новых условиях. Исследование показывает, что рефлексия на основе симулятора эффективнее неверифицированной саморевизии, однако главным узким местом остаётся переразработка физических механизмов, а не уточнение параметров. Даже при наличии информации об точных физических изменениях агенты испытывают трудности с достижением высокой производительности на полном наборе задач.

en.title: Adapting Agents: Overcoming Redesign Challenges in Evolving Environments
en.desc: The paper introduces PACE-Bench, a benchmark designed to evaluate self-evolving agents in adapting to changes in physics environments. It highlights the importance of simulator-grounded reflection over unverified self-revision for improving agent performance. The study reveals that while some self-evolving methods show promise, there is still a significant challenge in redesigning mechanisms to adapt successfully. Overall, the findings suggest that understanding and addressing the redesign bottleneck is crucial for advancing self-evolving agent capabilities.

zh.title: 自我进化代理的物理适应新基准
zh.desc: PACE-Bench是一个评估自我进化代理在物理适应任务中的基准，要求在环境变化后进行迭代代码重设计。研究表明，基于模拟器的反思方法比未经验证的自我修正更有效，但机制重设计仍然是一个主要瓶颈。该基准包含144对源环境和变异目标环境，代理需要在有限的尝试预算内适应代码以实现目标。结果显示，尽管一些方法表现良好，但整体性能仍有很大提升空间，强调了机制重设计的重要性。

papers.title: AnyTalk: Speech Animation for Arbitrary Characters Leveraging a Video Generation Model
papers.abstract: Abstract AnyTalk generates 3D speech animations for arbitrary characters without animation data by adapting video diffusion models via character-specific fine-tuning and optimizing blendshape parameters from synthesized talking-head videos, with a distilled real-time variant.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small We present AnyTalk, a novel method for generating 3D speech animations for arbitrary characters without requiring any animation data. While existing audio-driven 3D speech animation methods rely on character-specific training data or laborious rigging/re-meshing, AnyTalk circumvents these limitations by leveraging recent video diffusion models trained on extensive video datasets. We first adapt a pre-trained video diffusion model to a target character through our Character-specific Fine-tuning (CsF) technique. By fine-tuning on rendered images of the 3D character paired with zeroed-out audio embeddings (representing "no motion"), we eliminate the need for animation data while preserving the motion prior of large-scale video diffusion model. We then uplift the resulting talking-head video into a 3D speech animation by estimating blendshape parameters through a proposed optimization process. AnyTalk enables lip-synced animations across diverse face meshes and blendshape configurations, significantly reducing manual effort and data requirements. We further enhance usability by distilling AnyTalk into a streamlined network, AnyTalk_{RT}, thereby enabling real-time performance. By leveraging talking-head video generation, our method broadens access to audio-driven speech animation technology for arbitrary characters. The code is publicly available at https://serin-yoon.github.io/projects/anytalk/.

ru.title: Речь любого персонажа — анимация без данных
ru.desc: AnyTalk — это метод для создания 3D-анимаций речи для любых персонажей без необходимости в данных анимации. Авторы адаптируют предварительно обученную видео-диффузионную модель к целевому персонажу через технику Character-specific Fine-tuning, используя только рендированные изображения персонажа без движения. Затем они преобразуют полученное видео говорящей головы в 3D-анимацию путём оптимизации параметров блендшейпов. Для повышения практического применения авторы также создали дистиллированный вариант AnyTalk_RT, позволяющий выполнять анимацию в реальном времени.

en.title: Revolutionizing 3D Speech Animation Without Animation Data
en.desc: AnyTalk is a new method for creating 3D speech animations for any character without needing specific animation data. It uses video diffusion models that have been trained on large datasets and fine-tunes them for individual characters through a process called Character-specific Fine-tuning (CsF). This approach allows the generation of lip-synced animations by estimating blendshape parameters from talking-head videos, thus avoiding the complexities of traditional animation methods. Additionally, AnyTalk has a real-time version, making it easier to use for various applications.

zh.title: AnyTalk：无动画数据的3D语音动画生成
zh.desc: AnyTalk是一种新颖的方法，可以为任意角色生成3D语音动画，而无需动画数据。它通过角色特定的微调技术，适应预训练的视频扩散模型，从而避免了传统方法对特定训练数据的依赖。该方法通过优化混合形状参数，将生成的说话视频提升为3D语音动画，显著减少了手动工作和数据需求。AnyTalk还提供了实时性能的简化网络版本，进一步提高了可用性。

papers.title: Prior Audit-Repair Context Shifts LLM Verifier Thresholds Toward Leniency
papers.abstract: Abstract Prior audit and repair episodes in context reduce false alarms by shifting decision thresholds rather than discrimination, with repair content and audit verdict complementarily affecting different model families.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Automated checking pipelines increasingly place one language model as the checker and another (or the same one) as the fixer. We ask whether that wiring changes what the checker reports. Measuring false alarms on human-verified-correct ProcessBench traces with the present task held byte-identical, we find that a completed audit -> repair episode already in the model's context lowers false alarms in 15 of 15 model x wording combinations, by 2.8 to 11.5 percentage points against a length-matched non-audit control, a 9 to 25% reduction relative to that control. The direction contradicts what the accumulated-message literature predicts: an episode whose audit reported an error lowers false alarms further still, at all five wordings on the model where that manipulation lands cleanly, though a negativity asymmetry predicts more flagging. Decomposing the episode finds repair content and audit verdict complementary: different components carry the effect on different model families. Signal-detection analysis locates the change in the threshold rather than in discrimination -- the criterion moves in 15 of 15 combinations and survives correction in 13 while d' survives in none, though the d' test is half as sensitive by construction -- and a hand audit of 50 false alarms finds 82% simply wrong, so at this operating point the shift need not be harmful. With reasoning enabled the effect keeps its relative size on both models tested, and the threshold reading holds there too.

ru.title: Контекст аудита переучивает модель через смещение порога, а не улучшение различения
ru.desc: В статье исследуется, как предыдущие эпизоды аудита и исправления ошибок в контексте влияют на решения языковых моделей при проверке кода. Авторы обнаружили, что наличие завершённого цикла аудита и исправления снижает количество ложных срабатываний на 9-25% за счёт смещения порога принятия решений, а не улучшения дискриминативной способности модели. Содержание исправления и результат аудита дополняют друг друга, по-разному влияя на различные семейства моделей. Эффект сохраняется и при включении режима рассуждений, что указывает на универсальность механизма адаптации порога решения.

en.title: Reducing False Alarms Through Contextual Audits and Repairs
en.desc: This paper investigates how prior audit and repair episodes influence the performance of language models in reducing false alarms during automated checking tasks. It finds that having a completed audit and repair episode in the model's context significantly lowers false alarms across various model and wording combinations. The study reveals that the reduction in false alarms is due to a shift in decision thresholds rather than changes in the model's ability to discriminate between correct and incorrect outputs. Additionally, the research highlights that different components of the audit and repair process affect various model families in complementary ways, suggesting a nuanced interaction between these elements.

zh.title: 审计与修复：降低错误警报的关键
zh.desc: 这篇论文探讨了在机器学习模型中，审计和修复过程如何影响错误警报的发生率。研究发现，先前的审计和修复经历可以通过调整决策阈值来减少错误警报，而不是通过区分能力。不同的修复内容和审计结果对不同的模型家族有互补的影响。通过信号检测分析，研究表明阈值的变化是导致错误警报减少的主要原因，而不是模型的区分能力。

papers.title: Ventor-QTest: Threat-Model-Driven Verification of Vendor-Hosted LLM APIs
papers.abstract: Abstract Ventor-QTest audits hosted open-weight model APIs via repeated and long-sequence black-box probes, measuring average and extreme fidelity loss to detect degradation in long-horizon agentic performance.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small As large language models become increasingly widespread, third-party providers that deploy open-weight models have become an important part of the ecosystem. Auditing the quality of their inference APIs is therefore an open problem. We formalize hosted model routing as a stochastic process and propose \textbf{Ventor-QTest}, a composite black-box audit that requires no probability information from the target API. Its repeated-request component sends each frozen constrained context to the target multiple times, reconstructs a categorical output distribution from the returned text counts, and reports average fidelity loss (AFL) as a null-bias-corrected, within-window mean coarsened-KL statistic. Its long-sequence component uses independent runs to report extreme fidelity loss (EFL) through the empirical upper tail of a run-level reference-centered-surprisal statistic. Across three logprob-capable route conditions, AFL shows strong linear descriptive agreement with a logprob-derived coarsened-KL comparator. Across seven route snapshots, 20-run sequence probes reveal route-specific EFL variation. AFL and EFL have little detectable route-level association with GPQA-Diamond accuracy. In contrast, pronounced EFL coincides with a decline in Terminal-Bench pass rate as task exposure increases. This pattern may arise because correctness in long-horizon tasks is more sensitive to extreme fidelity loss. These results motivate reporting AFL and EFL jointly, particularly when auditing long-horizon agentic tasks. The open-source implementation is available at https://github.com/Tencent/AI-Infra-Guard/tree/main/services/api_checker/ventor_qtest.

ru.title: Аудит качества API моделей через анализ верности на длинных последовательностях
ru.desc: В работе предлагается Ventor-QTest — метод аудита API развёрнутых открытых языковых моделей через повторяющиеся чёрные ящики без доступа к логарифмам вероятностей. Метод измеряет потерю верности моделей двумя способами: среднюю потерю верности (AFL) через распределение категориальных выходов и экстремальную потерю верности (EFL) через анализ хвостов распределения. Авторы показывают, что AFL хорошо коррелирует с логарифмически-производными метриками, а EFL значимо связана с деградацией производительности на долгоактивных задачах. Результаты указывают, что совместный учёт AFL и EFL критичен для аудита моделей в долгоактивных агентных задачах.

en.title: Auditing Model APIs: Unveiling Performance with Ventor-QTest
en.desc: The paper introduces Ventor-QTest, a method for auditing the performance of hosted open-weight model APIs using black-box testing. It measures two key metrics: average fidelity loss (AFL) and extreme fidelity loss (EFL), which help assess the quality of model outputs over long sequences. By treating model routing as a stochastic process, Ventor-QTest can evaluate APIs without needing internal probability data. The findings suggest that monitoring both AFL and EFL is crucial for understanding performance degradation in long-horizon tasks, especially as task complexity increases.

zh.title: 审计开放模型性能的创新方法
zh.desc: Ventor-QTest 是一种审计开放权重模型 API 的方法，通过多次黑箱探测来测量平均和极端保真度损失，以检测长期智能体性能的退化。该方法将托管模型路由形式化为随机过程，并提出了一种复合黑箱审计，要求目标 API 不提供概率信息。其重复请求组件通过多次发送固定约束上下文，重建返回文本计数的分类输出分布，并报告经过无偏校正的平均保真度损失（AFL）。长序列组件则通过独立运行报告极端保真度损失（EFL），结果显示在长期任务中，EFL 的显著下降与任务暴露增加相关。

papers.title: ConceptFormer: Learning Adaptive Latent Concepts for Query-Document Alignment in Visual Document Retrieval
papers.abstract: Abstract ConceptFormer learns continuous latent concept representations to bridge visual evidence and semantic relevance for visual document retrieval without relying on text intermediates or raw visual annotations.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Visual document retrieval is a critical component of multimodal retrieval-augmented generation, aiming to identify query-relevant pages from document collections where evidence is distributed across text, layout, charts, and visual structures. Recent efforts toward finer-grained supervision primarily rely on textual descriptions or localized visual regions as evidence proxies. However, such supervision signals may either overlook complex visual structures or provide incomplete and inaccurate representations of the underlying evidence. To address these limitations, we propose ConceptFormer, a latent concept representation learning framework for visual document retrieval. ConceptFormer models query-relevant evidence as continuous, query-conditioned latent concepts that explicitly bridge localized visual evidence and semantic relevance, without requiring either textual intermediate representations or direct reliance on raw visual annotations. During training, ConceptFormer employs a strong vision-language model to dynamically determine the number of latent concept tokens and uses these concepts as an intermediate representation to bridge the semantic gap between queries and documents, thereby guiding the learning of the embedding space. Experiments on diverse visual document retrieval benchmarks demonstrate that ConceptFormer achieves 16.7\% and 22.1\% relative improvements in average NDCG@10 over the strongest visual retrieval baseline and the strongest OCR-based text retrieval baseline, respectively. Further analysis reveals that latent concepts effectively connect localized visual evidence with semantic relevance, enabling the retriever to capture both fine-grained textual cues and complex document-level visual structures while preserving strong retrieval alignment. Codes and data are available at https://github.com/Neuir/ConceptFormer.

ru.title: Мостик из скрытых концепций между визуальными признаками и семантической релевантностью
ru.desc: ConceptFormer — это фреймворк для обучения представлениям скрытых концепций, который решает задачу поиска визуальных документов без использования текстовых промежуточных представлений. Система моделирует релевантные запросу доказательства как непрерывные, условные на запрос латентные концепции, которые явно связывают локализованные визуальные признаки с семантической значимостью. Во время обучения используется мощная vision-language модель для динамического определения количества токенов скрытых концепций, которые служат промежуточным представлением для преодоления семантического разрыва между запросами и документами. Эксперименты показали улучшение метрики NDCG@10 на 16.7% и 22.1% по сравнению с существующими методами визуального поиска и текстового поиска на основе OCR.

en.title: Bridging Visual Evidence and Semantic Relevance in Document Retrieval
en.desc: ConceptFormer is a framework designed to improve visual document retrieval by learning continuous latent representations of concepts. It connects visual evidence directly to semantic relevance without needing text or raw visual annotations. By using a vision-language model, it dynamically creates latent concept tokens that help bridge the gap between queries and documents. The results show significant improvements in retrieval performance, demonstrating its effectiveness in handling complex visual structures and fine-grained textual cues.

zh.title: ConceptFormer：无文本中介的视觉文档检索新方法
zh.desc: ConceptFormer 是一种学习连续潜在概念表示的框架，旨在通过视觉证据和语义相关性来提升视觉文档检索的效果。它不依赖文本中介或原始视觉注释，而是将查询相关的证据建模为连续的、条件于查询的潜在概念。通过使用强大的视觉-语言模型，ConceptFormer 动态确定潜在概念的数量，并利用这些概念作为中介表示，缩小查询与文档之间的语义差距。实验结果表明，ConceptFormer 在视觉文档检索基准上取得了显著的性能提升，能够有效连接局部视觉证据与语义相关性。

papers.title: Gathered, Not Admitted: How Attention Brings a Latent Variable into Verbalizable Form
papers.abstract: Abstract In language models, flexible reuse demands attention-mediated gathering at a mid-depth window to make latent variables readable, without a selective gate, and readout measures poorly reflect actual use.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Language models hold latent quantities in a form they can report on, and more of a quantity is present in that form when the task requires reusing it flexibly. What causes a representation to enter that form is open, and the word workspace invites an admission story: a gate that decides what gets in. Testing it on open-weight models with Jacobian lenses, over a benchmark whose five arms share an identical context, we find no gate where it predicts one. Demand raises a concept's lens visibility beyond what applying an operator to a supplied value produces: +0.050 [+0.045, +0.057] in percentile rank on our primary checkpoint, positive on all four we measure, though that arm answers at ceiling and the accuracymatched contrast is stronger under that readout. At the same time one shared linear map decodes the variable from every arm, the control included, at 6.4-9.0x its selection-corrected floor. What produces the later readable form at the queried position is attention-mediated gathering inside a mid-depth window: separating patch depth from readout depth puts transport there at least 17x above anywhere shallower under non-saturating readouts, with no tested MLP output contributing positively inside it. Under the saturating percentile rank the same grid does not localise the window, which is a fact about that measure. An arm that needs the variable for nothing concentrates sevenfold less, so the window is demand-specific. That window has two measured edges, a survival failure below and destruction above, and it falls at the same fractional depth in a 64-layer hybrid and a 62-layer dense model from another family. We localise where the variable is installed and read, not the route from the passage, which transports nothing. But the readout is not a calibrated measure of use: three components move it to within 12% of one another and differ 7.4x in what they do to the answer.

ru.title: Внимание вместо гейта: как языковые модели собирают латентные переменные по требованию
ru.desc: В работе исследуется, как языковые модели хранят и используют латентные переменные для гибкого переиспользования информации. Авторы обнаружили, что вместо селективного гейта, как предполагалось ранее, переменные собираются через механизм внимания в середине глубины сети. Используя методы анализа якобиана на открытых моделях, они показали, что спрос на переменную увеличивает видимость её представления и одна линейная карта может декодировать переменную из всех контекстов. Исследование демонстрирует, что окно сбора данных специфично для спроса и имеет чётко определённые границы, хотя традиционные метрики плохо отражают реальное использование переменной.

en.title: Unlocking Latent Variables: The Power of Attention in Language Models
en.desc: This paper explores how language models manage and utilize latent variables through attention mechanisms. It highlights the importance of a mid-depth window for gathering information, which allows for flexible reuse of these variables without relying on a selective gate. The study reveals that the representation of a variable can be influenced by demand, affecting its visibility and usability in different contexts. Additionally, it discusses the limitations of current readout measures in accurately reflecting the actual use of these variables in model performance.

zh.title: 灵活重用潜在变量的关键在于注意力机制
zh.desc: 这篇论文探讨了语言模型中如何灵活地重用潜在变量。研究发现，在中层窗口中，注意力机制能够有效地收集信息，使得潜在变量更易于读取。通过对开放权重模型的测试，结果显示在特定任务中，变量的可见性会提高，且不同的任务需求会影响信息的集中程度。最后，论文指出，读取过程并不能准确反映变量的实际使用情况，存在多个因素影响最终的输出结果。

papers.title: ENTLORE: A Graph-Grounded Benchmark for Latent Organizational Reasoning in Enterprise Question Answering
papers.abstract: Abstract ENTLORE is a benchmark framework that evaluates enterprise question answering by requiring recovery of implicit organizational relations across routine documents, revealing that even with gold sources many latent reasoning questions remain unanswered.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Enterprise question answering is framed as retrieving internal documents and generating grounded answers. Routine enterprise records, however, are work by-products in which required organizational relations remain implicit across heterogeneous sources. Existing benchmarks provide realistic multi-source evidence, but often materialize a predefined answer path and therefore test the composition of stated facts rather than recovery of a target relation absent from the corpus. We call the latter capability latent organizational reasoning.   We introduce ENTLORE, a graph-grounded benchmark construction framework that reconstructs an audited enterprise world from routine documents, authoritative organizational tables, and operational records. Versioned organizational conventions certify derived relations in a truth graph, enabling complete golden answers and proof certificates. The aligned anonymized release exposes only the document corpus while withholding private structure and target relations. ENTLORE contains 2,341 documents from three source types and 907 questions spanning explicit lookup, cross-source composition, and latent organizational reasoning, evaluated across 56 model and access configurations. Structuring the released world as an induced entity graph or navigable knowledge base gives the strongest deployable results. Yet supplying gold documents still leaves 30.4% of latent questions unanswered, versus 12.6% and 6.2% for explicit and compositional questions. Enterprise QA therefore depends not only on document recall, but also on whether implicit organizational relations become usable. The benchmark, data, and code are publicly available at ENTLORE.

ru.title: Раскрытие скрытых организационных отношений в корпоративных документах
ru.desc: ENTLORE — это бенчмарк для оценки систем вопросно-ответных систем в корпоративной среде, которые должны восстанавливать неявные организационные отношения в документах. Система требует не только поиска документов и генерации ответов, но и латентного организационного рассуждения — способности выводить отношения, которые отсутствуют в корпусе. Бенчмарк содержит 2341 документ трёх типов и 907 вопросов, включая простой поиск, композицию информации из разных источников и латентные рассуждения. Исследование показало, что даже при доступе к золотым документам 30.4% вопросов остаются без ответа, что указывает на необходимость развития методов для извлечения и представления неявных связей в данных.

en.title: Unlocking Implicit Knowledge in Enterprise Question Answering
en.desc: ENTLORE is a new framework designed to assess enterprise question answering by focusing on the retrieval of implicit relationships within organizational documents. It highlights the challenge that even with high-quality data, many reasoning questions about these relationships remain unanswered. The framework constructs a truth graph from various enterprise records, allowing for a more comprehensive evaluation of latent organizational reasoning. By providing a structured approach to document retrieval and question answering, ENTLORE aims to improve the understanding and usability of implicit information in enterprise settings.

zh.title: ENTLORE：提升企业问答的隐含推理能力
zh.desc: ENTLORE是一个基准框架，用于评估企业问答系统，特别是通过恢复隐含的组织关系来处理常规文档。尽管有高质量的数据源，仍然有许多潜在的推理问题未能得到解答。该框架通过重建企业世界的图形结构，结合常规文档和权威的组织表格，提供了完整的黄金答案和证明证书。研究表明，企业问答不仅依赖于文档的检索能力，还取决于隐含的组织关系是否能够被有效利用。

papers.title: Drive, Pack, Fly: The Travelling Thief Problem with Drone
papers.abstract: Abstract The Travelling Thief Problem with Drone jointly optimizes ground routing, drone synchronization, and item selection to maximize profit, using mixed-integer programming, metaheuristics, and attention-based deep reinforcement learning with a hybrid refinement approach.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small In collection operations, accumulating payload progressively slows the vehicle, imposing a cumulative penalty on routing efficiency. An onboard drone can offset this penalty by retrieving outlying items, thereby shortening the makespan and increasing operational profit. However, travel time remains load-dependent, and each item collected by the ground vehicle shifts the arrival times that govern the drone's launch and rendezvous points. This paper introduces the Travelling Thief Problem with Drone (TTP-D), which maximises the collected profit, net of a time-based rental cost, by jointly optimising item selection, vehicle routing, and flight synchronisation. We formulate a mixed-integer linear program that solves small instances to optimality, and develop both metaheuristics and an attention-based Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) policy for larger instances. We further propose a learner-initialised hybrid solver, in which the DRL policy constructs an initial solution that a short annealing run subsequently refines. On two benchmark sets, this hybrid recovers most of the metaheuristic baseline's quality at a fraction of its computational budget, although the largest instances still require the baseline at its full budget. Finally, a sensitivity analysis reveals that the rental ratio is the primary driver of profitability, whereas the fleet parameters affect profit only at the margin.

ru.title: Синергия наземного транспорта и дрона: от оптимизации к обучению с подкреплением
ru.desc: В работе представлена задача коммивояжёра с дроном (TTP-D), которая оптимизирует выбор товаров, маршруты наземного транспорта и синхронизацию полётов дрона для максимизации прибыли. Авторы разработали три подхода: смешанное целочисленное линейное программирование для точного решения малых примеров, метаэвристики для средних задач, и внимательную нейросетевую политику глубокого обучения с подкреплением для крупных экземпляров. Предложен гибридный решатель, где DRL инициализирует начальное решение, которое затем уточняется имитацией отжига за счёт значительного снижения вычислительных затрат. Анализ чувствительности показывает, что стоимость аренды дрона является основным фактором прибыльности, в то время как параметры флота имеют лишь маргинальное влияние.

en.title: Maximizing Profit with Ground and Drone Optimization
en.desc: The paper presents the Travelling Thief Problem with Drone (TTP-D), which aims to optimize the collection of items using both ground vehicles and drones to maximize profit. It employs mixed-integer programming, metaheuristics, and an attention-based deep reinforcement learning approach to tackle the complexities of routing and item selection. The study highlights how the drone can alleviate the penalties associated with the ground vehicle's load, thus improving efficiency and profit margins. Additionally, a hybrid solver is introduced that combines initial solutions from deep reinforcement learning with further refinement techniques, demonstrating significant computational efficiency in solving larger instances.

zh.title: 优化无人机与地面车辆的协同作业
zh.desc: 本文提出了一种新的旅行小偷问题（TTP-D），该问题结合了无人机的使用，旨在通过优化物品选择、车辆路线和飞行同步来最大化利润。研究中使用了混合整数规划、元启发式算法和基于注意力的深度强化学习方法，以解决不同规模的问题。无人机可以通过收集偏远物品来提高效率，减少运输时间，从而增加操作利润。研究结果表明，租赁比例是影响盈利能力的主要因素，而车队参数对利润的影响则相对较小。

papers.title: Improving the matrix multiplication exponent with modern optimization and AlphaEvolve
papers.abstract: Abstract Refinements to combination loss analysis via reformulated optimization, machine learning-based algorithms, and AlphaEvolve yield an improved upper bound on the matrix multiplication exponent.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small The current best bounds on the matrix multiplication exponent ω are obtained through a refinement of the laser method called combination loss analysis (Duan et al., 2022; Williams et al., 2024; Alman et al., 2025). In this note, we address the optimization problem at the core of this approach and propose several improvements. First, we reformulate the optimization problem allowing us to solve it in a larger setting than was previously possible. Second, we leverage recent advances in machine learning to design a new optimization algorithm for this problem. Finally, we refine the resulting optimization algorithm with AlphaEvolve. Our combined approach yields an upper bound of ω < 2.371177, improving the previous best bound of 2.371339.

ru.title: Машинное обучение для оптимизации матричного умножения
ru.desc: В этой работе авторы улучшают анализ комбинированной функции потерь, которая используется для получения верхних границ показателя матричного умножения ω. Они переформулируют оптимизационную задачу, что позволяет решать её в более широком пространстве параметров, чем было возможно ранее. Затем они разрабатывают новый алгоритм оптимизации, используя достижения в области машинного обучения и применяют метод AlphaEvolve для дальнейшего совершенствования. В результате комбинированного подхода им удаётся улучшить верхнюю границу с ω < 2.371339 до ω < 2.371177.

en.title: Optimizing Matrix Multiplication with Machine Learning Innovations
en.desc: This paper presents enhancements to the analysis of combination loss in the context of matrix multiplication exponent optimization. By reformulating the optimization problem, the authors expand the solution space, allowing for more effective problem-solving. They also introduce a novel machine learning-based algorithm to tackle this optimization challenge, which is further refined using a technique called AlphaEvolve. As a result, the authors achieve a new upper bound on the matrix multiplication exponent, improving upon previous limits.

zh.title: 优化矩阵乘法指数的新方法
zh.desc: 本文提出了一种改进的组合损失分析方法，通过重新制定优化问题，结合机器学习算法和AlphaEvolve，得到了矩阵乘法指数的更优上界。我们首先重新构建了优化问题，使其在更大的范围内可解。其次，利用机器学习的最新进展，设计了一种新的优化算法。最终，通过AlphaEvolve对优化算法进行精细化处理，得到了ω < 2.371177的上界，优于之前的2.371339。

papers.title: When Context Bites: Detecting RAG Poisoning via Document-Level Attention Collapse
papers.abstract: Abstract D-SCAN detects retrieval poisoning by monitoring attention collapse dynamics in language model generations.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is indispensable for enhancing large language models. However, RAGs are increasingly susceptible to poisoning attacks, in which adversarial documents are injected to manipulate generator outputs. Previous methods rely on output-side signals such as perplexity and consistency checks to detect such attacks. Nevertheless, our analysis reveals that deliberate attacks often induce false confidence, where poisoned outputs exhibit even lower perplexity than benign ones, rendering uncertainty-based detection ineffective. To address this challenge, we explore the internal dynamics of the generator and identify a distinctive signature termed Attention Collapse. Unlike the dispersed attention in benign generations, attacked generations exhibit a decrease in entropy as attention concentrates on poisoned documents. Building on these findings, we propose D-SCAN (Document-level Signal Collapse Analysis), a lightweight detection framework that monitors attention dynamics to identify attacked generations. Extensive experiments on multiple attack benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our method. Moreover, D-SCAN can detect attacks even when they fail to alter the final answer. Code is available at https://github.com/yingtaoren/D-Scan.git.

ru.title: Обнаружение атак через анализ динамики механизма внимания
ru.desc: В статье предлагается метод D-SCAN для обнаружения атак отравления данных в системах поиска и генерации (RAG), которые дополняют языковые модели. Авторы выявили, что атаки вызывают эффект «схлопывания внимания» (Attention Collapse), когда механизм внимания концентрируется на отравленных документах, что отличается от рассеянного внимания при нормальной генерации. Метод анализирует внутреннюю динамику внимания генератора вместо проверки выходных сигналов, таких как перплексия, которые могут быть обманчивы при целенаправленных атаках. D-SCAN эффективно обнаруживает отравленные выходы даже когда атаки не изменяют финальный ответ.

en.title: Detecting Poisoning Attacks through Attention Dynamics
en.desc: D-SCAN is a novel framework designed to detect retrieval poisoning in language models by analyzing attention collapse dynamics during text generation. Traditional methods rely on output metrics like perplexity, which can be misleading as poisoned outputs may appear more confident. D-SCAN focuses on the internal behavior of the model, identifying a pattern called Attention Collapse, where attention becomes overly concentrated on harmful documents. By monitoring these dynamics, D-SCAN effectively identifies attacks, even when they do not change the final output of the model.

zh.title: D-SCAN：监测注意力崩溃以检测中毒攻击
zh.desc: D-SCAN是一种通过监测语言模型生成中的注意力崩溃动态来检测检索中毒的方法。检索增强生成（RAG）在提升大型语言模型的性能中至关重要，但它们越来越容易受到中毒攻击。传统方法依赖于输出信号，如困惑度和一致性检查，来检测这些攻击，但我们的分析表明，中毒输出的困惑度可能低于正常输出，导致基于不确定性的检测无效。D-SCAN通过监测生成器的内部动态，识别出一种称为注意力崩溃的特征，从而有效地检测到攻击。

papers.title: Position: AI Agents in Scientific Teams Should Be Studied as Human-Agent Systems
papers.abstract: Abstract Scientific collaboration with AI agents requires studying human-agent pairs to avoid risks like reduced inquiry diversity and to foster synergistic discovery.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Large language model-based agents are increasingly deployed as collaborators in scientific discovery yet most current work focuses on the autonomous capabilities of "AI Scientists". We argue that this overlooks the social aspects of scientific teamwork, and that studying AI Scientists as human-agent systems (HAS)--where the unit of analysis is the human-agent pair--is both underexplored and undervalued. We establish these points through literature and empirical analysis, and highlight recent incidences and studies which show that deploying agents in science without accounting for human-agent dynamics introduces near-term risks, including reduced diversity of scientific inquiry. Through analysis of real-world case studies, we show that scientists and agents can augment each other's capabilities. We call for new research that adopts the HAS lens to develop mathematical frameworks for understanding and fostering human-AI synergy in scientific discovery.

ru.title: Синергия вместо автономии: человеко-агентные системы для подлинного научного сотрудничества
ru.desc: Работа посвящена изучению человеко-агентных систем в научном сотрудничестве, где единицей анализа является пара учёный-агент на основе LLM. Авторы показывают, что сосредоточение только на автономных способностях AI агентов упускает социальные аспекты научной работы и создаёт риски, включая снижение разнообразия научных исследований. Через анализ реальных кейсов демонстрируется, что учёные и агенты могут дополнять друг друга и усиливать возможности один другого. Авторы предлагают новые математические фреймворки для понимания и развития синергии между человеком и AI в научных открытиях.

en.title: Enhancing Scientific Discovery through Human-Agent Collaboration
en.desc: This paper discusses the importance of studying the interactions between humans and AI agents in scientific research, rather than just focusing on the capabilities of AI alone. It highlights that understanding these human-agent pairs can help prevent issues like a lack of diversity in scientific questions and approaches. The authors provide evidence from literature and case studies to show that when scientists and AI work together, they can enhance each other's strengths. They advocate for new research that looks at these collaborations more closely to improve how humans and AI can work together effectively in scientific discovery.

zh.title: 促进人机协同，提升科学发现的多样性
zh.desc: 这篇论文探讨了人工智能代理与人类科学家之间的合作，强调了人机配对的重要性。研究表明，单纯关注AI科学家的自主能力可能会忽视科学团队中的社会互动。通过实证分析，论文指出不考虑人机动态可能导致科学探究的多样性降低。作者呼吁开展新的研究，以人机系统的视角来理解和促进科学发现中的人机协同。
